kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنعمل (form VII)
# أَنْعَمِلُ (ʔanʕamilu) /ʔan.ʕa.mi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# أَنْعَمِلَ (ʔanʕamila) /ʔan.ʕa.mi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# أَنْعَمِلْ (ʔanʕamil) /ʔan.ʕa.mil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
